evals.prompt: Build a dropdown menu widget for the design system.
evals.expected_output: An accessible, Semantics-aware widget following project conventions
expectations: Keyboard/back-button interaction and focus return are implemented, not just touch handling
Semantics (labels, roles, minimum touch targets) are applied correctly
Colors, text styles, and spacing come from the theme and design-system constants rather than hard-coded values
Widget state is managed deliberately (ephemeral state local, feature logic in a Cubit) rather than ad hoc
